raw_blocks: Companies That Make Products the World Relies on, Rely on PTC
From planes to medical devices to wind turbines to computers, our unique portfolio of software solutions enables companies to transform how they design, make, and maintain their products.
How We Help Our Technologies Our Purpose Our Impact Resources
How we help our customers
The global economy—and our everyday lives—run on the $14 trillion of manufactured goods produced each year.
With global supply chains, software-driven innovation, and ever-evolving customer demands, how these products are designed, manufactured, and serviced is more complicated than ever.

Our portfolio of software solutions manages data throughout a product’s lifecycle – driving excellence in engineering and design, efficiency in manufacturing and supply chain, and optimization in operations and service.

For nearly 40 years, PTC has consistently innovated in the product development space. Our customers are market leaders and disruptors across major manufacturing verticals, including auto, A&D, industrials, and life sciences.

Knowing the critical role our solutions play in the success of our customers, PTC has a comprehensive approach to working with customers, including embracing an open ecosystem, where our technologies can integrate with other vendor’s solutions.

To deliver comprehensive support, PTC enables an extensive global partner network to ensure customers have the tools and expertise necessary for success. By working together, we boost design, development, implementation, and production time.

The world’s best companies that design, make, and service products rely on PTC technologies, including 95% of the Fortune 500 discrete manufacturing companies. Top analyst firms consistently rank PTC as a leader in each of our technology categories.
Establish the foundation for digital thread and provide stakeholders across the extended enterprise with access to an authoritative source of real-time data.
Create 3D digital models of real-world products to define, share, review, simulate, and modify your designs before they’re manufactured.
Align and support hardware/software development processes and product regulatory compliance with traceability, transparency, and advanced workflows.
Maximize customer uptime by aligning your service parts management, technical communication, field service management, and product support operations.
Monitor, analyze, and act on your industrial data with real-time operational insights that enable bottleneck analysis, predictive maintenance, and energy efficiency.
Deliver highly visual training and work instructions to frontline employees or customers by overlaying 3D digital content onto their real-world environment.

Our purpose at PTC is to do more than just imagine a better world, it’s to help create it. This is reflected in our values, sustainability initiatives, social impact efforts, and innovative technology.
Our products enable manufacturers to design, build, and service their products more sustainably, while also considering other requirements.
Our software is helping to advance products all around us. See how our modern SaaS technology is transforming product development.
From giving back to our communities to empowering employees and customers, together, we are creating positive change.

Our 2025 Impact Report highlights our initiatives in reducing emissions, enhancing our products, and improving our communities. This year, as we celebrate 40 years of innovation, we were certified as a Great Place to Work in 22 countries. These milestones reflect our commitment to driving meaningful change with our employees, customers, and partners while conducting business with integrity and accountability.
